column1: # ESP-IDF partition table for pix-frame on an 8 MB flash.
# Documented in doc/PXA_spec.md section 4. The `animations` offset and size
# are also used by the `flash-assets` task in .mise.toml.
# 0x210000..0x40FFFF (2 MB) is intentionally left unallocated for a future
# OTA slot and `otadata` partition so `animations` never has to move.
